name: alibabacloud-dms-mcp-server

tools.name: addInstance
tools.description: Add an instance to DMS. The username and password are required. Only Aliyun instances are supported. Either instance_resource_id or host and port must be provided. The region is optional, but it's recommended to include it.If the instance already exists, it will return the existing instance information.

db_user.description: The username used to connect to the database
db_user.title: Db User

db_password.description: The password used to connect to the database
db_password.title: Db Password

host.description: The hostname of the database instance
host.title: Host

search_key.description: Optional search key (e.g., instance host, instance alias, etc.)
search_key.title: Search Key

db_type.description: Optional instanceType, or called dbType (e.g., mysql, polardb, oracle, postgresql, sqlserver, polardb-pg, etc.)
db_type.title: Db Type

env_type.description: Optional instance environment type (e.g., product, dev, test, etc. )
env_type.title: Env Type

tools.name: getInstance
tools.description: Retrieve detailed instance information from DMS using the host and port.

host.description: The hostname of the database instance
host.title: Host

tools.name: searchDatabase
tools.description: Search databases in DMS by name.

tools.name: getDatabase
tools.description: Obtain detailed information about a specific database in DMS when the host and port are provided.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the database instance
host.title: Host

tools.name: listTables
tools.description:
Search for tables by databaseId and (optional) table name. If you don't know the databaseId, first use getDatabase or searchDatabase to retrieve it.
(1) If you have the exact host, port, and database name, use getDatabase.
(2) If you only know the database name, use searchDatabase.
(3) If you don't know any information, ask the user to provide the necessary details.
Note: searchDatabase may return multiple databases. In this case, let the user choose which one to use.

search_name.description: Optional: Search keyword for table names
search_name.title: Search Name

tools.name: getTableDetailInfo
tools.description: Retrieve detailed metadata information about a specific database table including schema and index details. If you don't know the table_guid parameter, retrieve it using listTables.

tools.name: executeScript
tools.description:
Execute SQL script against a database in DMS and return structured results.If you don't know the databaseId, first use getDatabase or searchDatabase to retrieve it.
(1) If you have the exact host, port, and database name, use getDatabase.
(2) If you only know the database name, use searchDatabase.
(3) If you don't know any information, ask the user to provide the necessary details.
Note: searchDatabase may return multiple databases. In this case, let the user choose which one to use.

database_id.description: Required DMS databaseId. Obtained via getDatabase tool
database_id.title: Database Id

logic.description: Whether to use logical execution mode
logic.title: Logic

tools.name: createDataChangeOrder
tools.description:
Execute SQL changes through a data change order, and a corresponding order ID will be returned. Prefer using the executeScript tool for SQL execution;only use this tool when explicitly instructed to perform the operation via a order.If you don't know the databaseId, first use getDatabase or searchDatabase to retrieve it.
(1) If you have the exact host, port, and database name, use getDatabase.
(2) If you only know the database name, use searchDatabase.
(3) If you don't know any information, ask the user to provide the necessary details.
Note: searchDatabase may return multiple databases. In this case, let the user choose which one to use.

database_id.description: Required DMS databaseId. Obtained via getDatabase tool
database_id.title: Database Id

logic.description: Whether to use logical execution mode
logic.title: Logic

comment.default: Data correct order submitted by MCP
comment.description: Business context for the data change order
comment.title: Comment

annotations.title: 在DMS中创建数据变更工单

tools.name: getOrderInfo
tools.description: Retrieve order information from DMS using the order ID.

tools.name: submitOrderApproval
tools.description: Submit the order for approval in DMS using the order ID.

tools.name: approveOrder
tools.description: Approve or reject an order in DMS. The workflow_instance_id can be obtained from getOrderInfo.

workflow_instance_id.description: Approval workflow ID, can be obtained from getOrderInfo API
workflow_instance_id.title: Workflow Instance Id

tools.name: generateSql
tools.description: Generate SELECT-type SQL queries from natural language input.

model.description: Optional: if a specific model is desired, it can be specified here

tools.name: fixSql
tools.description:
Analyze and fix the SQL error based on the provided SQL statement, error message, and database ID.If you don't know the databaseId, first use getDatabase or searchDatabase to retrieve it.
(1) If you have the exact host, port, and database name, use getDatabase.
(2) If you only know the database name, use searchDatabase.
(3) If you don't know any information, ask the user to provide the necessary details.
Note: searchDatabase may return multiple databases. In this case, let the user choose which one to use.
